items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: So we left him in Tampa, Florida. That's the last time I saw him.

ctx.x: No, he didn't go. Because he couldn't go on account of something was wrong with his bladder. He had to have a place to stay by himself. Because you know, he wetted in the bed... So we left him in Tampa, Florida. That's the last time I saw him.
Then we had another act on the show called Shorty and David. David and Goliath -- Shorty. Goliath was Shorty -- Goliath, just like in the Bible.
